checks.name: logic_errors_explicitly_corrected
checks.value: R32 cluster-like terraces do not prove that risers are too low. Raising risers would amplify isolated islands. It is also invalid to equate protection of a drainage carrier with an arbitrarily wide blank agricultural setback when no surveyed bank/channel section exists. The first R33 attempt additionally mixed shoulder narrowing with a new phase frame, so its 0.844 m R33-R32 change could not be causally attributed. Final R33 isolates the drainage-shoulder variable and keeps R32 quantization unchanged.
checks.limit: reject low-riser, wide-setback and confounded-two-variable shortcuts

checks.name: failed_attempt_is_retained
checks.value: the first R33 machine run passed 36/37 gates but failed the bounded-change gate: sampled max R33-R32 surface change was 0.8442125319815688 m versus the unchanged <0.65 m limit. The wide-support result was not accepted; phase/step blending and smooth-union support were removed instead of relaxing the gate.
checks.limit: retain first-run failure rather than overwrite it

checks.name: real_world_constraint_is_explicit
checks.value: a real terrace-to-channel edge cannot be reconstructed quickly from the current 12.5 m macro DEM and photographs because selected-field microtopography, surveyed channel/bund/riser sections, bankfull width, inlet/outlet sill elevations and event water-management records are absent. The 12 m core and 24 m taper are synthetic QA parameters, not Yunnan engineering dimensions.
checks.limit: state missing real-world evidence that blocks fast realization

checks.name: xiaoma_truth_boundary_retained
checks.value: the Xiaoma/TLO intake still lists field location/boundary, field microtopography, bund section, channel section and water-control elevation as unknown; continuity and conservation appearance are not sufficient to establish hydraulic state. R33 creates no water head, depth, discharge or exchange law.
checks.limit: no necessary-condition -> sufficient-condition error
